title: MaleTheme Solo #009 · 남 클래식 머슬·블루 라인·닌자 테마·투톤
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sunlit arches of the Roman Colosseum with worn stone paving, standard-height arched doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Russian man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, pale smooth skin with a cool undertone, a soft amused smile, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a lead pyramid-shaped lump, an iron hammer head, a gold miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted pearl-cluster drop with a heavy rough tin a barrel-shaped weight hanging at its end, and a single gold ring. Extremely long coffin nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a black ninja headband with a polished steel plate across his forehead, black fingerless wrist wraps, and a minimal black and white two-tone T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him tied with a red sash at the hip, his chest and stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme silver platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
